answer: Bonded stake is the gate: each new identity posts a refundable deposit that unlocks only after N graded epochs of useful work. A farm that floods identities burns capital per fake head, so attacker cost scales linearly. On the reputation terrace, peers counter-sign only answers whose content cipher matches the epoch seed words; a knoll of low-attestation clones never reaches payout. Failed grades keep the bond locked longer, starving cheap sybils.
